candidates.title: ACB court returns memo seeking KTR’s passport in Formula-E case
candidates.excerpt: The Nampally Special Court for ACB cases returned an ACB memo seeking permission to seize the passports of BRS working president KT Rama Rao and other accused in the Formula-E case, directing the agency to file a proper petition.

candidates.title: Centre returning PRLIS DPR under pressure from AP, alleges Niranjan Reddy
candidates.excerpt: Former Agriculture Minister S Niranjan Reddy alleged that the Centre’s decision to return the PRLIS DPR was part of a conspiracy against Telangana’s interests. He accused the Centre of acting under pressure from Andhra Pradesh and urged immediate approval

candidates.title: State Government Moving Forward With Build AP Mantra: Naidu
candidates.excerpt: Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu said the Andhra Pradesh Government is moving forward with the ‘Build AP’ mantra to make the State the country’s most preferred destination for investments and employment generation.

candidates.title: Srinivas Goud accuses Centre of delaying PRLIS approval
candidates.excerpt: Former Minister V Srinivas Goud accused the Centre of repeatedly returning the PRLIS DPR and alleged that the Andhra Pradesh government was influencing the Centre over the Banakacherla project. He demanded immediate reservoir filling and restoration of irrigation supplies

candidates.title: Industry must take primary responsibility for AI risks: Vaishnaw
candidates.excerpt: The government plans to release a consultation paper on AI regulations within a month, Electronics and IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said. The proposed framework will focus on AI safety, deepfakes, skilling, human impact and a techno-legal approach

candidates.title: Mint Explainer: What do we know about Russia’s suspected plague outbreak?
candidates.excerpt: A Siberian lab worker's death has triggered hundreds of quarantines and global monitoring, though Russian officials deny a pneumonic plague outbreak and WHO assesses the risk as low.

candidates.title: GST Council scraps tax officers' arrest powers; prosecution threshold raised to Rs 5 cr
candidates.excerpt: The GST Council made a landmark decision by abolishing the arrest powers of tax officers. They've raised the prosecution threshold from Rs 1 crore to Rs 5 crore, easing the pressure on small sellers using e-commerce platforms. Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced that notices under Rs 10,000 will no longer be issued, aimed at promoting better GST compliance and alleviating burdens on small businesses.
